title: Learn the Mayfair Quickstep at home

extraction.teacher_style: The teachers work as a cooperative pair, taking turns explaining and demonstrating steps clearly. They break the sequence down into digestible parts before putting everything together.

lesson_structure.note: Teachers introduce themselves and the Mayfair Quickstep
Explanation of how the lesson will be structured in three parts
Demonstration and breakdown of the first part starting with holds and steps

steps_taught.name: Walks and Point
steps_taught.description: Three small steps forward followed by a point.

steps_taught.name: Side Close Side
steps_taught.description: Swapping places with side-close-side footwork and a point.

steps_taught.name: Three Step Turn
steps_taught.description: A three-step turn ending in a ballroom hold.

what_works: Constant verbal counting and foot clarification
what_hinders: No music during the initial breakdown

quotes.text: we're here to show you the wonderful sequence dance the Mayfair Quickstep.
We're going to do it in three different parts just for this space reason.
We're going to start with the outside foot.
face each other, turn to see each other here.
